```{r, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(GGally)
library(ggplot2)
library(car)
```


Cargamos los datos

```{r}
datos<-read.csv("datos/insurance.csv")
```

```{r}
datos_1<-datos[,1:3]
datos_2<-datos[,3:7]
```



```{r}
ggpairs(datos_1,aes(color=sex,alpha=0.5),
        upper= list(continuous= wrap("cor",size=2.5)))
```

```{r}
ggpairs(datos_2,aes(color=region,alpha=0.5),
        upper= list(continuous= wrap("cor",size=2.5)))
```

```{r}
summary(datos)
```


```{r}
reg_1<-lm(weight~sex+age+bmi, data=datos)
```


```{r}
reg_2<-lm(charges~smoke+children)
```
